title: land's wait-merge names a merge request stuck in GitLab's preparing state and its close-and-reopen remedy
goal: While land --wait-merge waits, it reads the request's detailed_merge_status, and a request still preparing after a few minutes (no diff refs, no pipeline) is named with the remedy that merged it (close and reopen the request, then backlog.py merge), instead of waiting out the whole timeout
notes: SP-ofvvong6 retrospective: ST-e6bueg2y wait-merge exit=1 after 1881 s (ops 2026-10-14T16:36Z); merge requests 1055 and 1056 sat in detailed_merge_status preparing with no diff refs and no pipeline; backlog.py merge got 405 then 422, the rebase API 500; closing and reopening each request made it mergeable within a minute. Triage 2026-10-16: its check names a test the pruned suite (D-6kei5o2z) lacks; no planted check yet: wait_merge (bl_land.py:2371) reads git only; the forge read and its branch param are new and unnamed; planting needs a fake glab and a full land flow. Restored by the SP-tsb23kev review: ST-lhtuyih2 dropped it under D-2tq4fhgs, but it describes an observed defect, so it is kept for a planted check (the reviewer's change to ST-lhtuyih2 gate g1). From the 2026-10-24 telemetry and query-log analysis: land --wait-merge stopped 7 times at its 30-minute bound on 2026-10-24 (exit 1 at 30.2 min), and all 7 landed 10 to 46 minutes after a rerun; the code lane's wait-merge step took a median 5.9 min that day (139 steps, p90 27.3 min) against a p90 of 2 min or less on 10-17 to 10-23. wait_merge polls git only (bl_land.py:2120-2147) and the telemetry cannot show whether these requests were preparing. If some were not: each poll reads the request's pipeline status (running, pending, failed, merged), a request still running at the bound leaves the run state waiting, and the land.step row records the last status.
